name: Takara Sushi (Logan, UT) Crisp Shrimp & Sweet Potato Tempura (Tentsuyu Sauce)
whyItWorks: Japanese tempura uses an exceptionally light, airy batter that absorbs less oil than Western heavy batter. Shrimp and sweet potato are low-residue and gentle.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Shrimp & Vegetable Tempura with warm tentsuyu dipping sauce.
watchOuts: Eat the tender interior shrimp and sweet potato; leave heavy fried batter remnants if feeling sensitive
